title: ¡Rojito atascado en el barro! 🚒💦 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: muddy countryside road after rain (big brown puddle, wooden fence, rainbow sky) + toy car wash with rainbow brushes and bubbles
story: Rojito drives into a big mud puddle, SPLASH, mud flies (problem)
He is stuck: his wheels spin and spin, mud splatters (struggle)
He honks his bell, nobody hears, uy (try 1)
Idea! He sprays water from his roof hose on the mud (smart fix)
The mud melts away and he rolls out, yay (success)
He drives into the car wash: rainbow brushes and bubbles (wash)
He comes out shiny red and sparkling (reward)
He spots another mud puddle and grins (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Splash! ¡Rojito en el barro!
[Verse]
Gira, gira, ¡no se mueve!
¡Tilín, tilín! ¿Quién me ayuda?
¡Agua, agua, chuf, chuf, chuf!
[Chorus]
¡Fuera barro, a rodar!
Burbujas de colores
¡Rojito, qué brillante!
[Outro]
¡Uy! ¿Otra vez?

locations.barro: A countryside dirt road just after the rain, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a big round brown mud puddle in the middle of the road, wet green grass, a small wooden fence, little puddles reflecting the sky, soft rounded green hills, a pale rainbow in the bright sky. No vehicles on the road.
locations.lavado: A cheerful toy car wash, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: big spinning round brushes in rainbow colors, foamy white soap bubbles floating in the air, shiny water drops, light blue and white tiled walls, a sign with a big water drop symbol, bright sunny light. No vehicles in the car wash.

shots: Low side view at ground level, the camera beside the puddle: the little red fire truck character drives from left to right straight into a big brown mud puddle, a huge splash of mud flying up high in the air, mud drops everywhere, his eyes wide with surprise.
He splashes into the puddle from the left, a big wave of mud flies up.
Extreme close-up of one black wheel of the little red fire truck spinning fast in thick brown mud, mud flying off the wheel, the red body and the golden number 1 visible above the wheel.
The wheel spins fast and throws mud backwards, but does not move forward.

Top-down view from high above: the little red fire truck character sunk in the middle of a round brown mud puddle on a country dirt road, mud up to his wheels, a small wooden fence and green grass around, he looks up at the camera with big pleading eyes.
He looks up and blinks sadly, his golden bell wobbles.

View from behind and a little above the little red fire truck: a strong arc of sparkling clear water shoots from the hose on his roof down onto the mud puddle in front of him, the mud washing away in brown streams, sunshine and a pale rainbow in the water spray.
Water sprays down onto the mud, brown streams wash away and the spray sparkles.
Wide shot of the countryside road: the little red fire truck character drives out of the puddle onto the dry road toward the car wash in the distance, mud on his sides, the pale rainbow in the sky.
He rolls out of the puddle and drives happily along the road.

Side view inside a toy car wash: the little red fire truck character, covered in mud, slowly passes between two giant spinning rainbow-colored brushes, white soap foam flying everywhere, his eyes squeezed shut and giggling.
The rainbow brushes spin against his sides, foam and bubbles fly, he giggles.

Close-up from the front in the car wash: the little red fire truck character perfectly clean and glossy, cherry-red paint shining, big sparkles twinkling on his windshield and bumper, a big proud smile, soap bubbles floating around.
Sparkles twinkle on his shiny paint and he smiles proudly as bubbles float by.

Low angle from behind the little red fire truck character on the country road: in front of him lies a new big brown mud puddle, he leans forward toward it with a mischievous grin seen in his side mirror.
He rolls slowly toward the new puddle.

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.
twist: nobody comes to help — Rojito remembers he IS a fire truck and uses his own hose
moral: ¡Tú también puedes! Usa lo que tienes.
experiment: self-solve twist (hero solves with his own ability) + low side-view opening instead of front close-up
continuity: mud: none (B1 start) -> mud on wheels and sides (B2-B6) -> spotless (B7) -> clean facing new puddle (B8); rainbow sky in all road shots
